title: Cornuside ameliorates cognitive impairments via RAGE/TXNIP/NF-kappaB signaling in Abeta(1-42) induced Alzheimer's disease mice.
authors: Lian, Wenwen; Wang, Zexing; Zhou, Fulin; Yuan, Xiaotang; Xia, Congyuan; Wang, Wenping; Yan, Yu; Cheng, Yunchi; Yang, Hua; Xu, Jiekun; He, Jun; Zhang, Weiku
journal: Journal of neuroimmune pharmacology : the official journal of the Society on NeuroImmune Pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山茱萸苷改善阿尔茨海默病小鼠认知功能，涉及RAGE/TXNIP/NF-κB信号通路，虽含虚拟对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cornuside has been discovered to improve learning and memory in AD mice, however, its underlying mechanism was not fully understood. In the present study, we established an AD mice model by intracerebroventricular injection of Abeta(1-42), which were treated with cornuside (3, 10, 30 mg/kg) for 2 weeks. Cornuside significantly ameliorated cognitive function of AD mice in series of behavioral tests, including Morris water maze test, nest building test, novel object recognition test and step-down test. Additionally, cornuside could attenuate neuronal injury, and promote cholinergic synaptic transmission by restoring the level of acetylcholine (ACh) via inhibiting acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and butyrylcholinesterase (BuChE), as well as facilitating choline acetyltransferase (ChAT). Furthermore, cornuside inhibited oxidative stress levels amplified as decreased malondialdehyde (MDA), by inhibiting TXNIP expression, improving total anti-oxidative capacity (TAOC), raising activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT). Cornuside also reduced the activation of microglia and astrocytes, decreased the level of proinflammatory factors TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta, iNOS and COX2 via interfering RAGE-mediated IKK-IkappaB-NF-kappaB phosphorylation. Similar anti-oxidative and anti-inflammatory effects were also found in LPS-stimulated BV2 cells via hampering RAGE-mediated TXNIP activation and NF-kappaB nuclear translocation. Virtual docking revealed that cornuside could interact with the active pocket of RAGE V domain directly. In conclusion, cornuside could bind to the RAGE directly impeding the interaction of Abeta and RAGE, and cut down the expression of TXNIP inhibiting ROS production and oxidative stress, as well as hamper NF-kappaB p65 mediated the inflammation.
abstract_zh: 已发现山茱萸苷（cornuside）能改善AD小鼠的学习和记忆能力，但其潜在机制尚未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们通过脑室内注射Abeta(1-42)建立AD小鼠模型，并用山茱萸苷（3、10、30 mg/kg）处理2周。山茱萸苷在系列行为学测试中显著改善了AD小鼠的认知功能，包括Morris水迷宫测试、筑巢测试、新物体识别测试和跳台测试。此外，山茱萸苷能减轻神经元损伤，并通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）和丁酰胆碱酯酶（BuChE）恢复乙酰胆碱（ACh）水平，以及促进胆碱乙酰转移酶（ChAT）活性，从而增强胆碱能突触传递。进一步地，山茱萸苷通过抑制TXNIP表达、提高总抗氧化能力（TAOC）、增强超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性，降低了以丙二醛（MDA）减少为标志的氧化应激水平。山茱萸苷还通过干扰RAGE介导的IKK-IκB-NF-κB磷酸化，减少了小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的激活，降低了促炎因子TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、iNOS和COX2的水平。在LPS刺激的BV2细胞中也观察到类似的抗氧化和抗炎效应，这是通过阻碍RAGE介导的TXNIP激活和NF-κB核转位实现的。虚拟对接显示，山茱萸苷能直接与RAGE V结构域的活性口袋相互作用。总之，山茱萸苷可直接结合RAGE，阻碍Abeta与RAGE的相互作用，并下调TXNIP表达，抑制ROS产生和氧化应激，同时阻碍NF-κB p65介导的炎症反应。
